IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives B. Sullivan, Anderson, Quall, Tom, Chase and Simpson

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that organ donation awareness be taught in public schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to organ and tissue donor education and awareness;adding a new section to chapter 28A.230 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the use ofanatomical gifts, including the donation of organ or tissue, for thepurpose of transplantation is of great interest to the citizens ofWashington state and may save or prolong the life or improve the healthof extremely ill and dying persons. The legislature further finds thatmore than ninety thousand people are currently waiting for lifesavingorgan transplants on the national transplant waiting list. More thanone thousand two hundred of these people are listed at Washington statetransplant centers. Nationally, eighteen people die each day as aresult of the shortage of donated organs. The legislature further finds that continuing education as to theexistence and maintenance of a statewide organ and tissue donorregistry is in the best interest of the people of the state ofWashington.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.230RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Organ donation awareness shall be taught in the public schoolsof this state. Organ donation education shall include instructionexplaining the organ and tissue donor registry created in RCW68.50.635. Students shall receive such instruction at least oncebeginning in ninth grade. (2) Instructional materials shall be developed in coordination withthe federally designated organ procurement organization for Washingtonstate. (3) All costs associated with the development, distribution, andimplementation of this curriculum shall be the responsibility of thefoundation established in RCW 46.12.510.
